inc.title: Incomplete orders
inc.sub: Customers who typed their number at checkout and left without ordering, newest first, day by day. Call or WhatsApp them, hand one to a teammate, confirm the order by phone, mark it handled.
inc.note: Only what the customer typed on the visible form is kept, and only while the switch below is on. Nothing is sent from here: a ready message only opens WhatsApp or SMS for you to press send. Confirm as order places a Cash on Delivery order the same way the website does; no money is asked or moved. A follow-up message goes only while its own switch below is on, and only to customers who said yes to offers.
inc.off: Keeping unfinished checkouts is off, so nothing new is kept. Switch it on in the card at the bottom of this page.

bag.d: For a signed-in customer who left things in his bag and never reached the checkout's number box: one reminder with a link that brings his bag back, then at most one offer under the offer rules. Two messages per bag, ever, and only where he said yes to offers.
bag.enabledHelp: When on, a signed-in customer's left bag gets one reminder by WhatsApp or SMS (only where he said yes to offers), with a link that puts his bag back on any phone. Off as it ships.
bag.firstAfterMinutesHelp: Minutes after the bag last changed.
bag.catchUpHoursHelp: A bag left longer ago than this gets no reminder (switching on never messages old bags).
bag.creditDays: Count an order as brought back within (days)
bag.creditDaysHelp: An order he places within these days of a message counts as the bag coming back.
bag.offer: Send one offer after the reminder
bag.offerHelp: The second and last message, with your code, only when the offer rules below allow it and the code works for him (its dates, uses and per-customer limit). Needs the permission to approve offers. Off as it ships.
bag.offerMinBag: Offer only for bags worth at least (taka)
bag.offerMinBagHelp: Bag prices; 0 means any bag the reminder went to. Lowering it needs the permission to approve offers.
bag.offerOncePerDays: At most one offer per customer in (days)
bag.offerOncePerDaysHelp: Counts offers from both follow-ups, so nobody learns to leave a bag for a code. Lowering it needs the permission to approve offers.
bag.stats: In the kept days: {sent} left-bag messages sent · {recovered} of those bags then came back as an order.

inc.notePlaceholder: What happened, for example: called, will order after payday

empty.later: Nobody has ordered after leaving yet.

unpaid.d: Prepaid orders whose payment failed or got no answer. The order is placed; its page has "Try again".

noPhone.text: Bags left without a checkout number: {n} (about {value} at bag prices).
noPhone.none: No bags were left without a number.
noPhone.signedIn: {n} of them belong to signed-in customers with a number on their account: the left-bag messages below can reach them. The rest can only be reached on the site (the bag stays in their browser) and by ad retargeting — nobody can message them.

card.d: What is kept, for how long, and when a checkout counts as left.
card.captureHelp: When on, the name, phone and address a customer typed but did not order are kept for your team's follow-up. Off as it ships.
card.keepDaysHelp: After this many days the typed details are wiped by the nightly privacy run.
card.leftAfterMinutesHelp: Minutes without a new word before a checkout shows here.
card.readOnly: Only someone who may change settings can change this.

err.INVALID_INPUT: Something in it is not right. Check and try again.
err.STALE: Someone else changed this. Reload the page.
err.NOT_FOUND: Not found: it may have become an order.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
err.UNAVAILABLE: Ordering from here is not set up.
err.NO_BAG: His bag is gone, so there is nothing to order.
err.NEEDS_PAYMENT: This order needs money first, so only the customer can place it.
err.CHECKOUT: The checkout refused this order (stock, address or price). Check the bag and try again.

fu.d: One reminder with a link that brings his bag back, then at most one offer. Two messages per unfinished checkout, ever, and only to customers who said yes to offers on that way.
fu.enabledHelp: When on, a customer who typed his number and left gets one reminder by WhatsApp or SMS (only where he said yes to offers), with a link that puts his bag back. Off as it ships.
fu.channelsHelp: The first way he said yes to offers on is used; a way he refused is never used.
fu.minStep: Only when he got as far as
fu.minStepHelp: Typed his number, typed his address, or reached payment.
fu.catchUpHoursHelp: A checkout left longer ago than this gets no reminder (switching on never messages old visits).
fu.phoneGapDaysHelp: A number that had a follow-up in these days gets no new one.
fu.offer: Send one offer after the reminder
fu.offerHelp: The second and last message, with your code. Needs the permission to approve offers. Off as it ships.
fu.offerCodeHelp: One of your live codes (Rules › Coupons). The link puts it on his bag by itself.
fu.stats: In the kept days: {sent} follow-up messages sent · {recovered} of those checkouts then ordered.
fu.rowOffer: Follow-up: {sent} of {max} sent · last {when} by {channel} (the offer)

inc.possibleHelp: Same connection as an earlier customer, different phone. Check before you treat them as one person.

journey.d: How far the left checkouts of these days got, and how many ordered afterwards.
journey.note: Device and step-by-step timing are not kept.

ct.warn: This only opens WhatsApp or SMS with the words filled in. You press send yourself. Write your own message only in the app.
ct.confirmAsk: He agreed on the phone? This places a Cash on Delivery order from his bag, the same way the website does.

v5.d: Marks an unfinished checkout whose connection matches an earlier customer under a different phone, and keeps the four ready messages the team can open in WhatsApp or SMS. Words in braces ({name}, {items}, {link}, {offer}) are filled in when the message opens.
v5.possibleMatchHelp: Off as shipped. It only marks; nothing is attached or merged.
v5.forgotHelp: Sent by a person after opening WhatsApp or SMS.
v5.sizeHelp: For a customer unsure about the size.
v5.deliveryHelp: Tells the customer you deliver to the area.
v5.offerHelp: Only someone who may approve a discount can open it, and types the offer words themselves.
